description: This file defines the GraphOperationBuilder class, which implements the OperationBuilder interface for constructing TensorFlow graph operations within the Java API. It includes methods for setting operation attributes, adding inputs and control inputs, and building the operation, utilizing native methods for underlying TensorFlow C API calls.

classes.name: GraphOperationBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating TensorFlow graph operations, providing methods to set attributes, inputs, control dependencies, and to finalize the operation construction.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Finalizes and creates the GraphOperation based on the current builder configuration.

methods.name: addControlInput
methods.description: Adds a control input to the operation being built.

methods.name: addInput
methods.description: Adds an input tensor to the operation.

methods.name: addInputList
methods.description: Adds a list of input tensors to the operation.

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Specifies the device where the operation will be placed.

methods.name: setAttr
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set various types of attributes for the operation, including strings, bytes, longs, floats, booleans, data types, tensors, shapes, and string lists.
